limitations: This is bounded visible-state coverage evidence for M19 only, not an all-4763-frame/global completion decision.

Every source frame was quantitatively compared; manual visual review covered all exposure-start states and all catalog representatives plus native suspicious pairs, not every frame at real-time playback.
The encoded video cannot establish author cel IDs or expose drawings hidden by subtitles, occlusion, crop or composition.
Difference thresholds are triage aids, not semantic truth; native inspection resolved suspicious exceptions. Sub-threshold or fully hidden source-author differences cannot be proven absent.
The 68 count denotes existing catalog-visible-state labels, not a proven count of unique author drawings.
This audit does not approve segmentation masks as production-clean alpha layers.
